Outline of biochemistry
The following
outline
is provided as an overview of and topical guide to biochemistry:
Biochemistry
, or
biological chemistry
(distinct from
chemical biology
), is the study of
chemical processes
within and relating to living
organisms
. A sub-discipline of both
chemistry
and
biology
, biochemistry may be divided into three fields:
structural biology
,
enzymology
, and
metabolism
. Over the last decades of the 20th century, biochemistry has become successful at explaining living processes through these three disciplines. Almost all
areas of the life sciences
are being uncovered and developed through biochemical methodology and research.
